title: Washington Square, San Francisco — NOAA NGS August 2022
worldOrigin: southwest; x east, y north; z above local flat ground
projectionNote: Local ground scale is Web Mercator multiplied by cos(37.8008 degrees). Scale varies slightly across the square. This is an approximate local frame, not a survey projection.
resolutionNote: Bilinear reprojection of original 0.25 m source from EPSG:6339 into shared EPSG:3857 frame; not an upscale of NAIP.
